title: Adrak Ka Sarbat
description: Adrak Ka Sarbat (Ginger Syrup) is a warming, pungent-sweet syrup made from fresh ginger extract and sugar base. This classical formulation relieves nausea. Treats motion sickness. Addresses flatulence. Relieves abdominal colic. Boosts sluggish digestion.
dosage: 10–15 ml mixed in warm water, or taken directly before meals to stimulate appetite
